description: NaMgV₂Bi₃O₁₀ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.86 Å. Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one BiO₅ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.27 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one BiO₅ square pyramid and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.89 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent BiO₅ square pyramids and corners with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.92 Å. There are three inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted BiO₅ square pyramids that share corners with three VO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.58 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.47 Å. In the third Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.45 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Mg, one V, and two Bi atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Mg, one V, and one Bi atom to form distorted ONaMgVBi trigonal pyramids that share  an edgeedge with one ONaBi₃ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONaMgBi₂ trigonal pyramid. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mg and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Mg, and two Bi atoms to form distorted ONaMgBi₂ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONaBi₃ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONaBi₃ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONaMgVBi trigonal pyramid. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Mg and one V atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one V and two Bi atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one V and two Bi atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one Bi atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one Bi atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Bi atoms to form ONaBi₃ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONaMgBi₂ trigonal pyramid and edges with two ONaMgVBi trigonal pyramids.
